summary: The diff implements most of REQ-1 through REQ-4, but has a critical violation of REQ-1 and REQ-2: the admin principal variable in the backend is declared as a non-stable var (not a stable var), meaning it will be reset on canister upgrade. Additionally, AdminLogin still calls setAdmin to bootstrap/claim admin even when an admin is already set, violating REQ-2's requirement that it must not call any bootstrap/claim function if an admin principal is already set. The storefront (REQ-3) and admin panel pages (REQ-4) appear largely restored.

missing_requirements.requirement: Store the admin principal as a stable variable so it survives canister upgrades without being reset.
missing_requirements.reason: In backend/main.mo, the admin principal is declared as 'var adminPrincipal : ?Principal = null;' — a non-stable variable. Without the 'stable' keyword, this will be reset to null on every canister upgrade, violating the core constraint.

missing_requirements.requirement: No code path during upgrade or redeployment can overwrite the stored admin principal.
missing_requirements.reason: Because the variable is not declared stable, any canister upgrade resets it to null, effectively allowing any caller to re-claim admin via the bootstrap function after each upgrade.

missing_requirements.requirement: AdminLogin must not call any bootstrap/claim function if an admin principal is already set in the backend.
missing_requirements.reason: AdminLogin.tsx still contains a code path that calls actor.setAdmin(principal) whenever the current caller is not admin, regardless of whether an admin is already stored in the backend. This can allow re-claiming admin after each upgrade resets the non-stable variable.

hallucinated_features.description: A Checkout.tsx page using Stripe payment integration (createCheckoutSession, isStripeConfigured) was included in the diff.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request explicitly calls for Razorpay as the only payment integration and lists third-party auth/payment providers other than Internet Identity and Razorpay as non-goals. A separate Stripe-based Checkout page was not requested.
